name: Navigate hotel sections and room selector
description: Verifies the primary hotel browsing experience works end to end.
steps: Navigate to Rooms, Dining and Amenities
expected: Each section is reachable and the selected room changes the explanatory copy.

name: Use mobile hotel navigation
description: Verifies the redesigned layout remains usable on a phone.
steps: Use the Rooms or Contact action
expected: The menu and mobile actions are usable without layout breakage.

name: Open the property gallery
description: Verifies gallery images open as a lightbox.
expected: The selected image opens in a lightbox and can be closed.

name: Use booking and contact CTAs
description: Verifies the key outbound hotel conversion actions are present.
steps: Open Contact and use the call or maps action
expected: Booking, phone and maps actions remain clickable and point to public hotel channels.
